_doc: Per-instance parameter sets for template.flow.json. Swap {{PLACEHOLDER}} -> value, import each as its own flow. LANDING_URL values are placeholders until the Unbounce pages' final URLs are confirmed — do not guess-publish. Vocabulary sourced from the 5 hand-built SEM Onramp drafts.

instances.OPENER_LINE: Running a SABIC grade and hit an allocation, price, or lead-time wall? We match drop-in alternatives fast — a specialist can confirm fit today.
instances.NEED_QUESTION: Which SABIC grade are you running now (or what spec does it need to hit)?

instances.OPENER_LINE: Looking for Lexan or Makrolon — or a polycarbonate that matches it without the wait? Tell us the grade and we'll get you to a PC specialist fast.
instances.NEED_QUESTION: Which PC grade (Lexan/Makrolon number) or spec are you after?

instances.OPENER_LINE: Ultem availability or pricing sending you looking? We stock PEI and matched high-heat alternatives — a specialist can confirm equivalence today.
instances.NEED_QUESTION: Which Ultem grade are you running, or what temp/spec does the part need?

instances.OPENER_LINE: Need Noryl or a modified-PPE equivalent? Tell us the grade or the electrical/dimensional spec and we'll route you straight to the right person.
instances.NEED_QUESTION: Which Noryl grade or PPE spec are you working against?

instances.OPENER_LINE: Valox on allocation or quoted long? We match PBT grades — connectors, automotive, glass-filled — with a specialist callback in hours.
instances.NEED_QUESTION: Which Valox grade or PBT spec are you after?
